description: Trigger: remote_pin_worker.rs submit_pending() receives RemotePinError::Unauthorized from the pinning service. It marks the individual job as 'failed' (is_fatal=true) and logs a warning, but the worker loop continues sweeping and submitting other pending jobs to the same service on the next poll cycle. Bad behavior: every subsequent article submitted to a service with an invalid API key will be attempted, fail with 401, be marked failed, and generate a warning log — indefinitely. The operator gets no clear signal to rotate the key, and the error storm fills logs.
title: remote_pin_worker: Unauthorized error on submit does not stop future submissions for that service
